subject: english
question:
From among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

Evelyn Glennie has **brought** **percusion** to the front of the **orchestra**, and **demonstrated** that it can be very moving.
solution:
The solution is **Precusion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in "Evelyn Glennie has **brought** percusion to the front of the **orchestra**, and **demonstrated** that it can be very moving." is Precusion.
 
• The correct spelt word is Percussion.
 
• Percussion - The striking of one solid object with or against another with some degree of force. 
 
 
• ​*For example : "the clattering percussion of objects striking the walls and the shutters"*
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Demonstrated - Give a practical exhibition and explanation of (how a machine, skill, or craft works or is performed).**

 
 
• **​***For example : "computerized design methods will be demonstrated"*
 
 
 
• **Orchestra - A group of instrumentalists, especially one combining string, woodwind, brass, and percussion sections and playing classical music.**
 
 
• **​***For example : "The band played an orchestra."*
 
 
 
• **Brought - Take or go with (someone or something) to a place.**
 
 
• **​***For example : "she brought Luke home from hospital"*
